projects.title: NZeTA PayNow & Batch Portal
projects.subtitle: Immigration & Border Security Payment Transformation
projects.challenge: Replace legacy payment gateway with modern Windcave multi-currency checkout while guaranteeing zero duplicate transactions across peak border application bursts.
projects.contribution: Led 5-person test squad, architected asynchronous callback recovery validation, coordinated external vendor releases, and established Go/No-Go evidence gate.
projects.outcome: Three zero-regression releases, 100% financial reconciliation accuracy, and seamless tourist levy / visa fee capture across 60+ countries.

projects.title: IPONZ SaaS Migration & Legacy V3.39–Optonum Integration
projects.subtitle: Intellectual Property Office Cloud & Database Modernisation
projects.challenge: Migrate millions of statutory patent, trademark, and design records from legacy Oracle databases to target SaaS platform without data loss or date drift.
projects.contribution: Formulated SQL source-to-target reconciliation and transformation-rule verification; performed hands-on IPONZ Legacy V3.39–Optonum seamless integration testing (Postman APIs including GetDocument & CheckDesignRenewal, Keycloak SSO/SLO authentication, user/customer sync, NFR performance baselines, ADO scripts); and represented MBIE in formal external vendor audit technical interviews.
projects.outcome: 100% target record verification, zero statutory date discrepancies, and executive sign-off for cutover weekend.

projects.title: One NZ Enterprise Mobility
projects.subtitle: All-of-Government Mission-Critical Telecommunications
projects.client: One NZ (Govt Streams: NZDF, Police, MSD, DOC)
projects.challenge: Ensure uninterrupted voice, secure mobile data, and priority routing across high-security government clients during enterprise network cutovers.
projects.contribution: Managed test and cutover risk governance across defence, police, and social development streams; designed failover regression matrices; directed live transition assurance.
projects.outcome: Zero mission-critical downtime, verified emergency call failover, and successful formal handover into live service.

projects.title: EPBR Digital Accessibility
projects.subtitle: Public Sector Regulated Accessibility & Usability Assurance
projects.challenge: Meet NZ Government Web Accessibility Standard 1.1 and WCAG 2.1 Level AA across complex interactive digital public forms.
projects.contribution: Embedded automated axe-core gates, conducted manual keyboard-only traversal, tested NVDA screen-reader flows, and audited color contrast.
projects.outcome: Zero Level A/AA non-conformances at audit and accessible access for citizens with assistive technologies.

projects.title: Open Banking & CDR API Assurance
projects.subtitle: Consumer Data Right Standards & Financial Grade API Security
projects.challenge: Validate OAuth2 mTLS authorization flows, CDR schema compliance, and payload encryption across high-volume banking APIs.
projects.contribution: Engineered automated API test suites simulating third-party financial apps; audited consent token lifecycles and latency under load.
projects.outcome: Full regulatory compliance, robust consent revocations, and secure integration with fintech partner ecosystems.
